setup: cd webserver/web && npm ci && npm run build
notes: Covers the Go webserver only: the macOS app (Swift + darwin c-shared dylib) needs Xcode and cannot build in the Linux sandbox. Node 22 comes from the sandbox image. ffmpeg is for server-side video thumbnails. Use `make -C webserver test-short`: the full interop tests need FUSE and the gocryptfs binary, which the sandbox cannot provide.
